column1: # Edge sites of clay minerals: the 2SPNE SC/CE model of Bradbury and Baeyens (two-site protolysis,
# non-electrostatic surface complexation).  Amphoteric edge sites of fixed capacity per kg of clay:
#   SOH + H+ = SOH2+  (log_k_plus)        SOH = SO- + H+  (log_k_minus)
# The strong sites (s) are few and bind metals strongly; the weak sites (w1, w2) set the proton buffering.
# illite (illite du Puy): Bradbury and Baeyens (2009a) Geochim. Cosmochim. Acta 73, 990-1003, Table 9.
# montmorillonite (SWy-1): Bradbury and Baeyens (2005) Geochim. Cosmochim. Acta 69, 4187-4197, Table A1
#   (after Baeyens and Bradbury 1997, J. Contam. Hydrol. 27, 199-222).
# Kaolinite has no 2SPNE parameter set in these papers, so it carries exchange sites only.
